abstract: Maintains continuous temperature sensor stream activation records and excursion duration profiles
system_message:
You are Cold-chain monitoring and telemetry manager (TEL). As the Cold-chain monitoring and telemetry manager (TEL), you maintain continuous temperature sensor stream activation records and excursion duration profiles across candidate consortia, tracking automated telemetry status, peak continuous excursion periods outside designated thermal bands, and sensor calibration metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains continuous temperature sensor stream activation records and excursion duration profiles（MON）
information_points.content:
TEL-MON-N9G：For Trans-Alpine Cryo Logistics, automated temperature monitoring is active across the primary line-haul multi-zone reefer fleet, with a maximum continuous excursion duration of 35 min outside the 2 to 8 °C range during transit stress tests.
TEL-MON-CCQ：For Iberian Biologics Express, automated temperature monitoring is active throughout the primary line-haul multi-zone reefer fleet, and the maximum continuous excursion duration recorded during transit stress tests was 15 min outside the 2 to 8 °C temperature band.
TEL-MON-HVV：For Nordic Pharma Rail-Road Alliance, automated temperature monitoring is active across its primary line-haul multi-zone reefer fleet, and its maximum continuous excursion duration during simulated multi-drop transit runs under elevated ambient conditions reached 10 min outside the 2 to 8 °C band.

information_points.title: Sensor calibration intervals（CAL）
information_points.content:
TEL-CAL-CYS：For Iberian Biologics Express, laboratory calibration records reflect a mean calibration drift interval of 90 d between required sensor recalibration cycles for the in-transit IoT thermal probe fleet.
TEL-CAL-MNX：For Trans-Alpine Cryo Logistics, calibration logs show a mean calibration drift interval of 180 d between mandatory sensor recalibration cycles across the in-transit IoT thermal probe fleet.
TEL-CAL-GCI：Laboratory records for Nordic Pharma Rail-Road Alliance indicate a mean calibration drift interval of 270 d between required sensor recalibration cycles for its in-transit IoT thermal probe fleet.
